name: David Brock Smith
desc: member of the Oregon House of Representatives
summary: David Brock Smith (born 1976/1977) is an American politician who has served in the Oregon State Senate since 2023, representing the 1st district, which covers all of Curry County and parts of Coos and Douglas counties. A member of the Republican Party, he was appointed to the Senate in 2023 to fill a vacancy. He previously served in the Oregon House of Representatives from 2017 to 2023 and as a Curry County commissioner.
